local_review.finding_body: The generated contribution violated the no-scope-creep and fix-by-weakening boundary in §FS-test-contract.2.9 and §FS-contribution-contract.4.8: beyond adapting the failing StaticFieldELResolver type assertion, it added an unrelated EL lambda scenario, added a malformed-expression MessageFactory scenario, and rewrote the already-passing FunctionMapper scenario solely to increase dynamic-access coverage. The observed JVM failure concerned only StaticFieldELResolver.getType returning null in Tomcat 10.1.
local_review.finding_title: Java runtime repair broadened into unrelated test coverage
local_review.fix_note: Restored the inherited ELSupport and FunctionMapper scenarios, removed the unrelated MessageFactory addition, and narrowed the StaticFieldELResolver repair to assert Tomcat 10.1's supported read-only behavior (null type with the property marked resolved). Finalization regenerated stats and proved all three test lanes and repository gates pass with the repaired tree.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete contribution against the fixes-java-run-fail rules and the contribution contract. The final diff is confined to org.apache.tomcat.embed:tomcat-embed-el:10.1.0, preserves the inherited test scenarios, adapts StaticFieldELResolver.getType to the supported 10.1 read-only result, keeps Native Image execution enabled, uses only reachability-metadata.json, and leaves exactly one latest index entry. The repair coverage gate passes independently: overall 39/45 (86.6667%) to 34/41 (82.9268%) and reflection 37/41 (90.2439%) to 33/39 (84.6154%) are each less than a 20-point drop, while resources 2/4 (50%) to 1/2 (50%) preserves the percentage. Local index gates were green. Authoritative finalization then passed current-defaults and future-defaults on the latest GraalVM, current-defaults on GraalVM 25, metadata validation, style checks, and regenerated statistics; the required second run exited successfully without another publishable change.
